entries.title: The book, reader labs and the next chapter
entries.summary: The book overview is available on Adaptivearts.ai, and the public reader lab includes CBE and CBE-IX exercises. The blueprintaistudio.app domain currently shows a coming-soon page. Studio and LMS development are the next part of the project; there is no public LMS launch to announce yet.

entries.title: Capability boundaries become hands-on exercises
entries.summary: CBE and CBE-IX profiles, worked examples and interactive labs are published. The Blueprint reader lab connects the two methods to the difference between a rule, authority and effective enforcement.
